VEHICLE PURCHASE AND ORDER AGREEMENT – TOYOTA

THIS AGREEMENT (herein after referred to as the ‘Agreement’) executed on ........... at (Place)……………

BETWEEN

State Trading Corporation of Bhutan Ltd., having its registered office at Simtokha, Thimphu, Bhutan (hereinafter jointly and severally called the “STCBL” , which expression shall include its legal representative, agent and assigns) of the PARTY OF ONE PART

AND

Lyonpo/Dasho/Mr/Ms/Mrs…….....…………D.o.B………...…bearing CID No………………Email Id…………… Phone No…………………. Presently residing at …………………………………… Permanent Adress village…………………...Gewog…………………… Dzongkhag………………………… (hereinafter jointly and severally called the “CUSTOMER” , which expression shall include its legal representative, successors and assigns) of the PARTY OF ANOTHER PART

WHEREAS, the STCBL and the Customer will be known individually as Party and collectively as Parties.
AND WHEREAS, the customer has approached STCBL with an interest to order and purchase of Toyota Vehicle. NOWINWITHNESS WHEREOF, the parties to the agreement hereby agrees to the following terms and conditions:

  1. The Parties to the Agreement has read and understood the Terms and Conditions for placing order for TOYOTA vehicle(s) provided in customer Order Form – I and other terms and conditions of the agreement.
  2. The Parties to the Agreement agree to abide by and accept, the terms and conditions set out in the duly completed Customer Order Form -I attached herewith.
  3. The Customer Order Form -I completed by the customer shall constitute an integral part of this Agreement.

    Please tick as appropriate

  1. Vehicle Booking (Part Payment)/ Consideration
  1. The customer shall clearly choose the option and fitments by ticking the specific item in the given vehicle specification, with the customer’s signature. Whereas, STCBL shall treat as a final and confirmed order. Hence, STCBL shall not accept any further changes.
  2. The price quoted above is only for reference and budgeting purposes, which is subject to change due to exchange rate fluctuation and price revision from the Principal Company. Therefore, the price ruling at the time of delivery shall be applicable as the final price.
  3. Any increase or decrease in the cost due to exchange rates shall be communicated before final billing.
  4. The customer shall make a minimum 15% selling price of the STCBL, excluding all tax, as an advance deposit at the time of placing the order.
  5. Money Receipt/Journal: (No./date) ……………………………… ...of the advance paid (copy to be enclosed) of Nu…………………………(In words)…………………………………………………..
  6. Orders may be canceled between the 1st and 20th of the same month in which the agreement is executed. However, a cancellation fee of Nu. 10,000 (Ten Thousand) per vehicle shall be deducted from the advance money as a processing fee.
  7. Hereafter, the cancellation will result in the forfeiture of the full advance payment as an administrative cost.
  8. Upon confirmation of the order, the vehicle will be delivered within 8 months in normal cases, if no circumstances of delay in the production or shipment drop from the principal company’s end.
  9. Failure to deliver on the promised date will result in compensation to the customer at a rate of 0.05% for each day of delay, up to a maximum of 10% of the advance payment for the entire delayed period.
  10. In any delay due to circumstances deemed unavoidable by STCBL, under such circumstances, STCB shall be communicated in written notice and shall not be responsible or held liable for any consequential costs as a result of Force Majeure events;act of Gods, accident, riots, epidermic, pandemic, quarantine, natural catastrophes, governmental acts or omissions, change in laws or regulation, fire, explosion, generalized lack of availability of raw materials or energy.

  1. The status of vehicle shipment may be notified periodically to the customer over the Order Tracking System in STCB’s website..
  2. The vehicle's arrival date will be communicated to the customer, and must take delivery within 2 weeks of that date. If the delivery exceeds 2 weeks, a stockholding charge at a rate of 0.05% for each day of delay, up to a maximum of 10% of the vehicle cost, will be applied entire delayed period.
  3. The balance payment must be completed before delivery, unless a financing arrangement has been agreed and for bank-financed purchases, customers may need to provide valid proof of loan approval before the vehicle is delivered.
  4. The point of delivery of the vehicle shall be from STCBL, Phuntsholing and shall be made in person or in presence of your representative.
  5. Options for delivery of vehicle(s) to any other specific location shall be offered. However, cost of availing the facility will be additional to the customer.
  6. All taxes shall be applicable as per the Department of Revenue and Customs Rules and Regulations (Ministry of Finance). The tax rates may be subject to change in accordance with Government Policy and shall be treated as final at the time of delivery of the vehicle.
  7. In the event that any additional taxes or charges are imposed by the Ministry of Finance after the delivery of the vehicle, the Customer agrees to bear such additional costs. These additional taxes shall automatically become applicable to the Customer and shall be payable upon demand.
  8. Failure by the Customer to pay the purchase price of the vehicle or any applicable taxes, including taxes arising from revisions in Government Policy, shall not constitute grounds for the termination of this Agreement. The STCBL retains the right to pursue all legal remedies to recover the outstanding amounts from the Customer.

  1. Payment terms and conditions
    1. The full payment is Nu (in figure & words):
      2. STCB Selling Price: Nu. ..........................
      Customs Duty (CD): Nu. ...........................
      Excise Tax (ET): Nu. ...........................
      Goods and Services Tax (GST): Nu. ..........................
      Selling Price with Full Tax: Nu. ...........................
    2. STCBL shall pay all the applicable taxes (ET, CD & GST) at the point of vehicle entry on behalf of the customer and the customer must refund the exact amount at the time of delivery of the vehicle. However, If the Customer is eligible for a tax rebate (quota holder), the customer may claim it directly from RRCO through BITS.
  1. Validity of Agreement

    This Agreement shall remain in effect until the ordered vehicle, specifically the vehicle, is successfully delivered to the customer.

  1. Termination Clause
    1. Termination upon Delivery of Vehicle

    This agreement shall automatically terminate upon the successful delivery of the ordered vehicle to the purchaser, unless otherwise specified in this agreement.

    1. Termination by Breach

    Either party may terminate this agreement by providing written notice to the other party if the other party materially breaches any provision of this agreement, including failure to pay the balance amount for the ordered vehicle within the specified time frame.

    1. Consequences of Termination

    a) Upon termination of the agreement, any advance payment made during the vehicle order process shall be forfeited.

    b) STCBL reserves the right to sell the ordered vehicle to another buyer or take any other action deemed appropriate by STCBL’s management.

  1. Dispute Resolutions

    This Agreement shall remain in effect until the ordered vehicle, specifically the vehicle, is successfully delivered to the customer.

  1. Good Faith Negotiations: In the event of any dispute, claim, or controversy arising out of or relating to this Agreement, the Parties shall first attempt to resolve the matter amicably through good faith negotiations. Each Party shall promptly notify the other in writing of the nature of the dispute and their intention to resolve it. The Parties shall use all reasonable efforts to reach a mutually acceptable resolution within ten (10) days from the date of receiving such notice.
  2. Referral to Court: If the Parties are unable to resolve the dispute through negotiations within the specified timeframe, either Party may refer the matter to a competent court of jurisdiction in accordance with the applicable laws of the Kingdom of Bhutan. Each Party retains the right to seek appropriate legal remedies or equitable relief as necessary through the court system.
  3. Governing Law: This Agreement and any disputes arising under it shall be governed by the laws of Kingdom of Bhutan.
